A '''torpedo''' was a type of [[Missile/Legends|projectile]] that could be fired both in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]<ref name="SWS" /> and [[Water/Legends|underwater]].<ref name="SS" />

==Space torpedoes==
[[Proton torpedo/Legends|Proton torpedoes]] were the most common space torpedo. They carried a [[proton-scattering energy warhead]], and were commonly utilized as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] armaments.<ref name="SWS" />

==Underwater torpedos==
Torpedoes designed to be used underwater could not be used in an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] or in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="SS" /> Sub-aquatic installations could be defended by torpedo launchers, such as [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] [[S-4 Underwater Torpedo Launcher]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref> Some [[Starship/Legends|starships]], such as the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]], could be fitted with underwater firing torpedo launchers.<ref name="SS" />
